newsitem.title: USA: North America bunkers mostly lower, supply driven.
newsitem.headline: North America bunkers mostly lower, supply driven.

text.p: North American bunker prices were mostly lower this week amid light demand and suppliers wanting to be rid of barrels before the holiday, players said.
In New York Harbor, spot 380 CST on Tuesday was down $2 to between $132 and $133 a tonne, with spot 180 CST also down $3 to $135/136. The fall erased gains made last Thursday.
"It's mostly supply-side driven. Suppliers want to move barrels in this short week," said one East Coast trader.
NYMEX will be closed Thursday and Friday for the Thanksgiving holiday weekend.
On the Gulf Coast, Houston spot 380 CST slipped $1 to $124/$125 and 180 CST dropped $2 to $128/129, players said.
West Coast markets were reported mixed. Los Angeles prices were weaker this week by about $3 but the Seattle market rose $2 in light trade, players said.
-- Laney Salisbury, New York Energy Desk + 1 212 859-1631
